caption: The drawing depicts two views of a wooden object with a circular base and a knob-shaped handle. The upper view shows the bottom of the object, which is intricately carved with a pattern that includes multiple fern-like or feather-shaped elements radiating out from a central, rounded, and ribbed form. These carvings are highlighted in brown and greenish tones, with fine lines defining the texture. The wood itself is depicted in shades of light to medium brown, with darker areas suggesting shadow and curvature, as well as faint lines indicating the grain of the wood. The lower view presents the object from the top, focused on the smooth, dome-shaped handle and the round, flat base, which has slight cracks and texture lines suggesting the natural state of the wood. The drawing features a plain, beige background with a single-lined rectangular border framing the composition.
title: Butter Mold
